description_en: Changes the control mode of a resource from managed mode to unmanaged mode
description_zh: 通过调用UpdateServiceManagedControl接口对托管状态的资源进行解托管
kebab_example: aliyun ga update-service-managed-control --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type Accelerator --resource-id ga-bp149u6o36qt1as9b0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServiceManagedControl

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the GA instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the value of RequestId as the value of ClientToken. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource whose control mode you want to change.

Set the value to Accelerator, which specifies a standard GA instance
parameters.help_zh:
操作的资源类型。取值：

 Accelerator：标准型全球加速实例
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource whose control mode you want to change
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The control mode of the resource.

Set the value to false, which changes the control mode of the resource from managed mode to unmanaged mode.

You can change the control mode only from managed mode to unmanaged mode
parameters.help_zh:
设置资源托管模式。取值：  

false：解除当前资源的托管状态。

当前仅支持解除托管
parameters.name: service_managed
